export_csv.name: Export to CSV
export_csv.description: Writes the zone change history to a CSV file in the configuration folder, with optional filters. Returns the file path and the number of rows.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Relative to the configuration folder. Timestamped automatically when empty.

persons.name: Persons
persons.description: Names or person.* entity ids to include. Empty = all.

delimiter.name: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Comma (standard) or semicolon (Excel with a French locale).

export_excel.name: Export to Excel
export_excel.description: Writes an .xlsx workbook (Summary sheet + one sheet per person with per-zone statistics) to the configuration folder.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Relative to the configuration folder; .xlsx is appended when missing.

persons.name: Persons
persons.description: Names or person.* entity ids to include. Empty = all.

clear_history.name: Clear history
clear_history.description: Empties the CSV file after making a backup copy (.bak-avant-effacement-<date>). Administrators only.
